note: Saudi Arabia, read on the Premium Residency Center's own portal (pr.gov.sa, a government site that renders its pages in the browser, read by honest rendering) on 2026-10-30: the product pages, the general benefits and the frequently asked questions (expanded). The Gifted Residency targets sports, cultural and artistic talents, on a recommendation from the Ministry of Culture or of Sport and proof of the means to live in Saudi Arabia; it is a fixed five-year residency, renewable once, for a one-time fee of SAR 4,000, and leads to permanent residency for one who keeps meeting the criteria, has lived in Saudi Arabia 30 months within the five years and is endorsed by the ministry (5 kept as the years before permanent residence, a reading of 'during five years'). Every premium residency lets its holder work in private establishments and change jobs freely, outside the professions reserved for Saudis, and own a business under the Investment Law; 'any' is the form's nearest term, the reserved professions it doesn't hold. The limited duration premium residency is for one to five years, renewable, at SAR 100,000 for each year (kept as its fee, which is per year; the term varies with the years bought, so none is written), on proof of financial means; the unlimited duration premium residency is permanent, SAR 800,000. Applications are made online through the centre; the FAQ speaks of applicants from inside the Kingdom settling their former residence first and says applying is open to anyone meeting the requirements (read as either). The fee is paid within 30 days of approval; no time to a decision is published. The FAQ says premium residency doesn't qualify its holder for Saudi nationality, so no route counts toward it. The ordinary employer-sponsored work visa and residence (iqama) of the Ministry of Human Resources and the Passports directorate aren't read here: their portals (my.gov.sa, absher.sa, moi.gov.sa) answer with a bot check or not at all.

sources.title: Premium Residency Center, Gifted Residency
sources.said: This Product targets sports, cultural, and artistic talents. ... Obtain permanent residency upon meeting the conditions. ... Obtaining a recommendation from the Ministry of Culture or the Ministry of Sports based on the applicant's field ... A fixed term residency for five years, renewable once upon meeting the eligibility criteria for the product and having a residence for a period of 30 months during five years either consecutive or non-consecutive. ... Permanent residency when continuously meeting the eligibility criteria for the product and having a residence for a period of 30 months during five years either consecutive or non-consecutive, and receiving an endorsement to have a permanent residency from the Ministry of Culture or Ministry of Sports. ... Onetime fee: 4,000 SAR

sources.title: Premium Residency Center, Limited Duration and Unlimited Duration Premium Residency
sources.said: الإقامة المميزة المحددة : إقامة محددة لسنة واحدة وحتى 5 سنوات، قابلة للتجديد. ... الإقامة المميزة غير محددة المدة : إقامة دائمة. ... الإقامة المميزة المحددة : 100,000 ريال سعودي لكل سنة. ... الإقامة المميزة غير محددة المدة : 800,000 ريال سعودي. ... العمل في منشآت القطاع الخاص والانتقال بينها للزوج والزوجة والأبناء. ... تقديم ما يثبت الملاءة المالية للمتقدم

sources.title: Premium Residency Center, General Benefits
sources.said: Flexibility to move from one establishment to another. ... The entitlement to work in the private sector and move between establishments applies to the husband, wife, and dependents

sources.title: Premium Residency Center, FAQs (answers expanded)
sources.said: التقدم بطلب للحصول على الإقامة المميزة متاح لأي شخص يستوفي المتطلبات التالية ... يُسمح لحامل الإقامة المميزة بالعمل في المنشآت الخاصة وتغيير الوظائف بحرية. يشمل هذا الحق أفراد العائلة المشمولين. لا يشمل المهن المخصصة للسعوديين. ... ينص النظام على أن الإقامة المميزة لا تؤهل حاملها للحصول على الجنسية السعودية. ... يجب على المتقدمين من داخل المملكة إنهاء جميع المسائل المتعلقة بالإقامة السابقة قبل الحصول على الإقامة المميزة. ... يجب على المتقدم دفع الرسوم خلال 30 يومًا من إشعاره بالموافقة على الطلب.
